name: lumina
description: Lumina — a cinematic discovery platform with a local-first AI memory. Your watch history, beautifully archived; an AI companion that actually knows your taste.
author: dnh33

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
